question: During which Five-Year Plan was the focus on 'Self-reliance' particularly emphasised?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Third Five-Year Plan**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Third Five-Year Plan** (1961-1966) focused heavily on achieving **self-reliance** in various sectors, particularly agriculture and industry.
 
• This plan aimed at making India self-sufficient in the production of food and reducing dependency on imports for essential goods and resources.
 
• The emphasis on **self-reliance** was driven by the challenges of foreign exchange reserves and the need for economic independence.
 
• Under this plan, there was a significant thrust on increasing **domestic production** capabilities by investing heavily in agriculture, infrastructure, and basic industries.
 
• The plan was disrupted by the **Indo-China war (1962)** and the subsequent economic crisis, but it laid the groundwork for India's long-term focus on self-sustainability.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **First Five-Year Plan (1951-1956):**

 
 
• Focused primarily on **agriculture** and aimed at resolving food shortages caused by Partition and World War II.
 
• Major investments were made in irrigation, dams, and land reforms.
 
• The success of this plan was evident in increased agricultural production.
 
 
 
• **Sixth Five-Year Plan (1980-1985):**
 
 
• The Sixth Plan focused on **poverty alleviation**, infrastructure development, and rural employment.
 
• This marked the beginning of the **Integrated Rural Development Programme (IRDP)**.
 
• It also emphasized improving living standards and reducing inequalities between rural and urban areas.
 
 
 
• **Ninth Five-Year Plan (1997-2002):**
 
 
• This plan aimed at **economic growth** with social justice and equity.
 
• It focused on improving **human development indices** like education, health, and employment.
 
• The plan attempted to integrate economic reforms with developmental objectives.
 
 
 
• **Indo-China War (1962):**
 
 
• Occurred during the **Third Five-Year Plan**, leading to an economic disruption.
 
• India faced increased defense spending, which impacted the planned allocation of resources for development.
 
• Despite the war, the emphasis on **self-reliance** remained intact as a cornerstone of India's economic strategy.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Self-reliance:**

 
 
• Refers to the ability of a country to meet its own economic needs without heavy reliance on external sources.
 
• It includes **domestic production** of food, industrial goods, and essential resources.
 
• Key sectors involved in achieving self-reliance include **agriculture, manufacturing, and infrastructure development**.
 
 
 
• **Five-Year Plans in India:**
 
 
• India's Five-Year Plans were introduced in **1951** to promote planned economic development.
 
• These plans were formulated by the **Planning Commission**, which was replaced by the **NITI Aayog** in 2015.
 
• Each plan focused on specific objectives such as poverty alleviation, industrial growth, and infrastructure improvement.
